name: Carte de visite (photograph)
definition: Small albumen portrait photograph mounted on a card about 2.5 by 4 inches, common from the 1860s.
notes: AntiquePhotoStock lists CDVs (carte de visite) as its own browse type; some dealers combine with cabinet cards

name: Cabinet card
definition: Photograph mounted on a card about 4.25 by 6.5 inches, which replaced the carte de visite from the late 1860s.
notes: AntiquePhotoStock lists Cabinet cards as its own browse type

name: Snapshot
definition: Informal amateur photographic print made with a hand camera, unmounted and usually small.
notes: AntiquePhotoStock lists Snapshots as its own browse type
